item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 18/Jun/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A southerly airstream will bring a few showers to Guangdong in the next couple of days. Under the dominance of an anticyclone aloft, the weather will be generally fine and very hot over southern China during the weekend to early next week. A broad trough of low pressure is expected to bring unsettled weather to the vicinity of the central part of the South China Sea and the Philippines in the middle and latter parts of next week.
